The seed bank now marks some lots as **must ship**: a lot the bank has promised to another bank
goes in the crate whatever it is worth. The season's file gains a `must` column, and the packer's
report has to show which lots were promised and how heavy the crate is.

Change the planner so that every must-ship lot is in the crate, the rest of the room goes to the
most valuable fit, and the report stars each must-ship lot and prints the total weight. A crate
whose must-ship lots alone are too heavy is refused.

Run prints the report for this season's lots. Submit runs every test of the project, the earlier
steps' included, and compares the report with the expected one.
